title: Eye of Het II
start: Talk to Icthlarin at the entrance to Het's Oasis.

recommended.t: Pontifex shadow ring (for quick access to the Senntisten cathedral)
Ring of duelling (for quick access to Het's Oasis)
Shard of Erebus (to make glacors non-aggressive)
The boss portal in War's Retreat or the Boss portal in Max Guild attuned to the Arch-Glacor

rewards.t: Eye of Het (broken), a relic which can be offered to the mysterious monolith to unlock the Blessing of Het relic power. (The relic doesn't require repairing.)

steps.t: Talk to Icthlarin at the entrance to Het's Oasis. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to the stranger near the tents north-east of the oasis.
Search the chest just outside of the tent with the bank chest to find some badly-hidden notes.

sub.t: It is located to the left near the red tent.
Make sure to proceed through all the dialogue, or you won't be able to progress.

steps.t: Talk to Azzanadra at the Glacor Front (south of the cathedral in Senntisten). [Chat: 1 Talk about the Duel Arena. › Any]

sub.t: Wearing the shard of Erebus will keep glacors from attacking along the way.
You can teleport to Arch-Glacor (and Azzanadra) using an attuned boss portal at War's Retreat, or by using the grouping system.

steps.t: Head to the cathedral and talk to the gods. (You can use the pontifex shadow ring to teleport directly to the cathedral.)

sub.t: Talk to Seren. [Chat: 3 Talk about the Duel Arena.]
Talk to Zamorak. [Chat: 3 Talk about the Duel Arena.]
Talk to Armadyl. [Chat: 3 Talk about the Duel Arena.]
Talk to Saradomin. [Chat: 3 Talk about the Duel Arena.]

steps.t: Attempt to talk to Trindine in the following locations.

sub.t: At the northern entrance to the cathedral.
West near Nex at the stairs near the Nodon Front.
South beside Helwyr at the Glacor Front.
East over the bridge at the Croesus Front.
North of the Senntisten Dig Site's archaeologist's workbench. [Chat: 1 Gather Everyone.]

steps.t: Talk to any god in the cathedral. (Select who you want to accuse)
Talk to Azzanadra. [Chat: Any] (If the player logs out or teleports out during this sequence, they can speak to Azzanadra at the Glacor Front to resume it.)
p: Zamorak and Khazard reveal their involvement.

steps.t: Talk to Icthlarin at the entrance to Het's Oasis again.
